subject: Follow-up: token economics anchor & route addition for renewal
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@datasprout.ai>, Sam Park <sam@datasprout.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap — token economics anchor & next steps

Hi Emily / Sam — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so everyone stays aligned.

Key points we discussed
- Current usage: ~4M tokens / mo (inference + chat). You expect a step-up to 9–12M tokens/mo after Q4 feature launch.
- Primary ask: anchor on a target $/1M tokens that meets your budget expectations while preserving latency SLOs. You referenced a comfort range around $450–$600 / 1M tokens depending on model mix and routing.
- Technical constraints: need consistent 100–200ms 95p latency for the primary model; fallback routes okay for non-latency-critical workloads.

Quick pricing notes (high level)
- Blended rate model when adding specialized routes usually ends up between the high-cost base model and low-cost routing for cheaper models (example math attached). See renewal_anchor_calc.csv.
- Caching/prefix reuse and KV cache savings can materially lower per-token cost for repeated prompts — we should quantify with a sample day of traffic.

Proposed next steps
1) Ben to produce 2–3 concrete pricing scenarios (reserved step-up, blended-route mix, prepay commit) with unit economics ($/1M tokens) and expected monthly cost. Target by EOD Tue (13 Jul).
2) Emily/Sam: please share a top-line budget range and procurement timing (PO/term) so we can tailor scenarios to your timeline.
3) Technical: Laura to coordinate a short traffic-sample run (1 hour) to estimate caching and effective token reduction.
4) Schedule: 30-min pricing review on Wed 14 Jul — propose 16:00 ET. If that doesn't work, suggest alternatives.

Attachments: renewal_anchor_calc.csv (simple spreadsheet with blended math and example token mixes).

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily@datasprout.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — token economics anchor & next steps

Tessa — thanks for the crisp recap. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Budget anchor: internally we can push to $500 / 1M tokens as a target if overall monthly spend stays within our uplift budget (~$5K–$7K/month incremental in early months while we prove the feature). $450 is an optimistic stretch, $600 is our current cap if we need more reserved capacity.
- Performance: keeping the 95p latency under 200ms for the primary route is non-negotiable for our UX. If the blended plan increases tail latency we will request prioritization of the primary route.
- Routing mix: we expect ~70% of traffic to remain on the primary model and ~30% on cheaper models for background/analytics flows post-launch.

Procurement timeline: we need a signed amendment by end of July to align with our Q3 budget cycle — that means receiving concrete pricing + an invoice schedule by 21 Jul.

I've attached our internal budget note that flags the $500/1M target and the procurement deadline.

On the sample run — happy to upload a sampled day export. Sam, can we confirm data access for Laura?

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Product, DataSprout
emily@datasprout.ai

Emily / Sam — looping in concrete scenarios as promised. I kept the math simple and focused on the $/1M anchor you mentioned. See attached pricing_scenarios_v1.pdf for a cleaner table, pasted a short summary below.

Scenario A — Reserved step-up (low admin, moderate discount)
- Assumes committed monthly capacity to 10M tokens (12-month term)
- Unit price: $520 / 1M tokens
- Benefits: predictable monthly spend, priority capacity during bursts
- Tradeoff: minimum commit required to unlock price

Scenario B — Blended route mix (flexible, model-aware)
- Primary model (70%): $700 / 1M
- Background/cheap route (30%): $300 / 1M
- Blended effective rate: 0.7*700 + 0.3*300 = $560 / 1M
- Benefits: preserves performance for core UX, reduces cost for background traffic without a heavy commit

Scenario C — Prepay + bigger commit (best unit economics)
- 12-month prepay / bigger commit to 12M tokens/mo average
- Unit price: $480 / 1M tokens (paid up-front monthly amortized)
- Benefits: best $/1M, includes 10% free token buffer for traffic variance

Notes:
- Caching impacts: if Laura's sample run shows >15% effective token reduction through prefix reuse, all scenarios improve by ~10–15% on effective spend. We should model that in the attachment.
- Latency guarantees: Scenario B preserves the highest perf on primary route by design; Scenario A/C can be configured with reserved nodes for SLO compliance.

Immediate next steps (short actionable list)
1) Emily/Sam: confirm which scenario(s) you want a formal quote for (A/B/C) — reply by 21 Jul to meet procurement.
2) Laura: run the 1-hour sample and drop results in the shared drive link Ben shared — helps firm up caching uplift.
3) Legal/Procurement: once scenario chosen, we will draft a short amendment and target signature before 31 Jul.

Attachments: pricing_scenarios_v1.pdf (includes amortized month-by-month cost, sample blended calculations, and commitment language).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
